question: What are the best alternatives to the Baseus 100W USB-C cable?
query: best alternatives to Baseus 100W USB-C cable Anker UGREEN Belkin Cable Matters reviews specifications 2026

judge.why: The answer recommends Anker first and cites Walmart, UGREEN, Newegg, Adorama and Macworld, with no dealectric.com source and no product of ours.

| Cable | Max charging | Data speed | Best use |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| UGREEN 100W | 100W | 480Mbps | Everyday charging |

| Belkin BoostCharge | Model-dependent | Model-dependent | Brand alternative |
| JSAUX USB-C 3.2 | 100W | 10Gbps | Budget + performance |

## My recommendation

If you're replacing the **Baseus 100W cable specifically**, I'd shortlist these three:

- **UGREEN 100W** — for a simple, dependable charging cable.
- **Anker 333 100W** — if you want an established competitor with positive long-term user experience.
- **Cable Matters 10Gbps** — if you want something more versatile than a charging-only cable.

One important note: a 100W cable needs an **E-Marker chip** to safely support 5A charging. Also, 100W charging capability does not automatically mean high-speed data transfer or video support. Check all three specifications before purchasing.
